recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-47616 unless OO later changes its morphology value set policy; separate EU IG morphology tickets should be handled in their own workflows.
issue_request: FHIR-47616 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking that BodyStructure.morphology's example value set be cleaned up because the ballot value set included disease/pathology examples rather than morphology. The approved resolution was to update the example value set to 118956008 |Body structure, altered from its original anatomical structure (morphologic abnormality)|.
initial_application: Commit 8d706af07d07c6c92b41965482fd5735bffeb3c4, later merged through HL7/fhir PR #3552 as cd8e130841, changed source/bodystructure/valueset-bodystructure-code.xml from the previous broader anatomical/acquired body-site hierarchy to a SNOMED CT concept is-a filter on 118956008. Later commits on the file adjusted metadata such as shareability/status, not the FHIR-47616 hierarchy.
additional_context: BodyStructure is listed as an active resource in source/fhir.ini and BodyStructure.includedStructure.morphology still has an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/bodystructure-code. OO minutes from 2025-03-13 record FHIR-47616 in a Persuasive block vote approved 12-0-0. Searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion; similarly named EU IG tickets are outside FHIR-core.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source and combined branch already contain the approved 118956008 description and compose filter.
